claims.explanation: GW-441756 is a selective TrkA/NTRK1 inhibitor, so sensitivity is most likely driven by tumor dependence on NGF/TrkA survival signaling. TrkB/BDNF signaling can bypass TrkA blockade, providing a resistance mechanism, as seen in Ewing sarcoma where combined TrkA/TrkB inhibition is required for maximal effect.
